# Vendor identification for scanned Wi-Fi/BLE devices. The ~40k-entry OUI table and the
# BLE company-ID table are generated by scripts/gen_vendor_table.py into vendor_table.inc.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "vendor_lookup.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES
        json
)
